component-metadata.author: knimeuser
component-metadata.description:
Creates one of several bar plots visualizing values in all selected columns and in all rows. Unless summarization (calculating mean or median of all values in all rows or columns) should be performed, each value in each selected cell will be plotted as an individual bar.
It is possible to either use the columns or the rows as the grouping variable. This grouping variable will be used to group bars on the X axis, to summarize columns (if "summary plot" is selected) or to set facets (if "faceted plot" is selected).
